mods.name: Stalpo Mapart Helper
mods.description: This is a mod for managing large mapart collections

releases.notes:
[17 July 2025, 21:20 utc] - the release was updated. Re-download it

### changes
- **Improved map namer**
    - Added support of maps that use common sequence (i.g. `[1/99]`, `[2/99]`, `[3/99]`, `[{cur}/{total}]`)
      `{total}` is optional
    - Added `incrementY (true/false)` flag. You can specify what coordinate the mod should increase first
    - The mod now doesn't take renamed maps matching the sequence from the shulkers but updates the sequence
    - Renaming process is now more stable
- **Added map sorter by name**  (It's buggy now but enough to sort almost every mapart)
- **Added putting maps in/pulling out of bundles**

### other patches
- fixed the game crash in the sound tick caused by using bundles
- fixed the game crash in the chat render
- fixed rare `map id is null` causing the game crash by forcing it to use `-1` id instead of `null` 
actually it's not the id itself but the `MapIdComponent` is null for some reason. I can't reproduce it using only the mod

These patches are always applied if the mod is present in your mods, so it fix crashes caused by other mods

### zero-tick is back??
kinda.
You can use it (set `delay` to 0) to copy low amount of maps, like 1-2 shulkers, but the safe value is 10 ms. Base delay in the mod haven't been changed, it still remains at 65ms, but I highly recommend you to use 10 ms delay on 2b2t
The server will eventually kick you if you use any value lower than 10 ms 

UPD: I do not guarantee you won't be kicked at 10 ms. It's just a good value to me. Increase it if you're getting kicked
UPD2: [20 july 2025] - haosemaster has limited the inventory actions again. Be careful

releases.notes:
**ver 1.0.7**
*fixed copying of maps if there is one map in the slot only

 ### Copying maparts
 - Number of inventory actions reduced by half!
 - Empty maps are now taken from the whole inventory, not just the hotbar.
 - The copier checks if you have enough empty maps **before** copying the shulker!
 
 ### Inventory actions
 - The number of packets is reduced (when possible) by checking if the target slot is empty.
 
 ### Inventory desync
 - Fixed desync when moving items to/from a shulker or copying maps
 
 ### Delay
 - now the delay between inventory actions can be changed using `/delay <value>` command
 - default delay is 20ms
 
 ### 2b2t
 We have now something like this: `N inventory actions per T time`
 Specific values ​​are unknown. I found safe number of actions is ~3 per tick. You can set any delay if you want to test it!
 It's still possible to use 0 delay, but the server will kick you after the limit is reached. Be careful!
 
#### The instruction on `How to auto name maparts` in the README was updated!
